pharm: Semisynthetic oral cephalosporin; cell-wall synthesis inhibitor (beta-lactam)
quick: 300 mg q12h or 600 mg once daily
With or without food; separate from antacids/iron by 2 h
Animal studies reassuring; use only if clearly needed
Not detected in milk after single 600 mg dose
No specific adjustment in the label
Watch for diarrhea (C. difficile) and allergy
summary: Cefdinir is an oral third-generation (extended-spectrum) cephalosporin for mild-to-moderate infections caused by susceptible bacteria, including community-acquired pneumonia, acute exacerbations of chronic bronchitis, sinusitis, pharyngitis/tonsillitis, otitis media, and skin/skin-structure infections. It blocks bacterial cell-wall synthesis. Once-daily dosing is as effective as twice-daily for most indications (skin infections require twice daily). It must be separated from antacids and iron by at least 2 hours.

dosage.d: 300 mg every 12 h or 600 mg once daily
dosage.n: Pneumonia and skin infections: 300 mg q12h x 10 days

dosage.d: 300 mg q12h x 5-10 days or 600 mg q24h x 10 days
7 mg/kg q12h or 14 mg/kg q24h (max 600 mg/day)
dosage.n: Once-daily not studied for skin infections

dosage.d: Adults: 300 mg once daily; Peds: 7 mg/kg (max 300 mg) once daily
dosage.n: Hemodialysis removes cefdinir; dose 300 mg or 7 mg/kg every other day, resume after each session

admin: May be taken with or without food
Shake oral suspension well before each dose; confirm concentration (125 or 250 mg/5 mL)
Take at least 2 hours before or after antacids (Mg/Al) or iron supplements
Complete the full prescribed course even if feeling better
Reconstituted suspension may be stored at room temperature for 10 days
moa: Cefdinir is a semisynthetic cephalosporin that binds penicillin-binding proteins and inhibits bacterial cell-wall (peptidoglycan) synthesis, producing a bactericidal effect against susceptible organisms. It is stable to many beta-lactamases.

absolute: Known allergy to the cephalosporin class of antibiotics
relative: History of penicillin/beta-lactam allergy (cross-hypersensitivity may occur in up to ~10%)

preg: Pregnancy Category B (legacy label): not teratogenic in rats or rabbits; no adequate well-controlled human studies. Use during pregnancy only if clearly needed.
lact: Following single 600 mg doses, cefdinir was not detected in human breast milk. Iron-fortified infant formula does not significantly interfere with absorption.
renal: In CrCl <30 mL/min, reduce dose (adults 300 mg once daily; pediatric 7 mg/kg up to 300 mg once daily). Hemodialysis removes cefdinir — dose 300 mg or 7 mg/kg every other day and at the end of each dialysis session.
hepatic: No specific dosage adjustment is provided in the label.

moderate: Antacids (aluminum/magnesium) — reduce cefdinir absorption by ~40%; separate by >=2 hours
Iron supplements / iron-fortified foods — reduce absorption by up to 80%; separate by >=2 hours
Probenecid — inhibits renal excretion, ~doubles AUC and prolongs half-life
interactions.food: May be taken without regard to meals; food reduces Cmax/AUC modestly but not clinically significantly.
interactions.diagnostics: May cause false-positive urine glucose (Clinitest/Benedict's/Fehling's) and a positive direct Coombs test; ketones in urine may give false-positive results. Reddish stools may occur from non-absorbable iron-cefdinir complex.

rare: Stevens-Johnson syndrome, toxic epidermal necrolysis (class effect)
emergency: Severe or bloody diarrhea suggesting C. difficile colitis

monitoring: Watch for diarrhea during and after therapy (C. difficile)
counsel: Antibiotics treat bacterial, not viral, infections — take exactly as directed and finish the course
Separate from antacids and iron supplements by at least 2 hours
Reddish stools may occur if also taking iron — this is harmless
Report any rash, swelling, or breathing difficulty immediately
Report watery or bloody diarrhea, even weeks after stopping
Shake liquid well and use the supplied measuring device
pk: Dry powder 20-25C (68-77F); reconstituted suspension stable 10 days at room temperature
pearls: Once-daily dosing is as effective as twice-daily for 10-day courses (except skin infections — give BID)
Separate from antacids and iron by >=2 hours; iron can reduce absorption by up to 80%
Harmless reddish stools may occur from a non-absorbable iron-cefdinir complex
Oral bioavailability is only ~16-25%; suspension is ~120% relative to capsules
Hemodialysis removes cefdinir — redose after dialysis
Cross-reactivity in up to ~10% of penicillin-allergic patients
missed: Take as soon as remembered; skip if near the next dose. Do not double. Maintain spacing from antacids/iron.
overdose: Human overdose data are limited; beta-lactam overdose may cause nausea, vomiting, epigastric distress, diarrhea, and convulsions. Treatment is supportive. Hemodialysis removes cefdinir and may help in serious toxicity, particularly with renal impairment.
